A third-party client for JMComic, written in Kotlin and Compose. No interstitial ads, and it doesn't record what you read; login credentials are encrypted before being written to disk\n\nThere are two reader layouts, vertical scrolling and page flipping, with seamless stitching for long images. Favorites, progress and block lists live on your device, and can sync to your own cloud drive via WebDAV. Blocking works by keyword, category or tag, and matching works disappear from lists
